name: human_bob_bangs
about: The sisters' bob with bangs (HUMAN_PLAN §1.3 / §5.4: Aletheia blonde, Aporia black, one style): straight hair parted down the middle under a blunt fringe, falling over the skull to a level cut at the jaw with the ends turned under. Two groups: the FRINGE (a U-shaped section at the front of the scalp, combed forward and dropping over the forehead to a line just above the brows) and the HANG (everything else, combed away from a crown whorl and split by a centre part, lying over the skull in layers, the crown's strands on top, then hanging free to the jaw line). Grown on the H4b woman.

scalp.why: H1: the hairline per azimuth of the head frame (front 0, sides 90, nape 180; the centre 45 % of the way from the head-top socket to the head joint: (0, 1.540, 0.048) on the H4b woman): a soft frontal line about 6.5 cm above the brows, temples recessed to ~27 deg at 42 deg round, the sideburn dropping to the ear's level in front of it (73 deg), the line curling over the ear (84-92 deg) and down behind it to the nape; an 8 mm fade (the 0.5-1 cm density falloff of HS §2.2)

fringe_zone.why: g06: the hang strands rooted on top just behind a 73 deg fringe section (el 74-83) combed forward and fell over the face (147 strands in the face box): the fringe section reaches back to 81 deg, as a full blunt fringe is cut from

hang_zone.why: c04: two hang guides rooted in the zones' shared soft edge (el 80) took the fringe's forward flow and hung their cards down the face; the hang group now roots only clear of the fringe section

sdf.why: H2: the head, neck and shoulders' signed distance (the whole skin's winding number; 2.5 mm cells), built once per base and cached by its sha1

sources.why: c02: the forward comb's soft edge reached into the hang group's first row behind the fringe (el 80-85), whose guides then ran forward over the face: the comb now stops inside the fringe section

g07: the top just behind the fringe section (el 80-88) still combed forward from the crown and fell over the face; there the hang hair combs back, away from a point in front of the brow, and over the crown

g01: the temples' hang strands combed forward from the crown and fell in front of the face; behind the fringe the sides comb down and a little back, so they fall beside the cheeks (the bob frames the face)

singularities.name: centre part
singularities.why: H1: the centre part from the fringe section's back edge over the top to the crown whorl: the flow splits left and right across it, so the top hair falls to the sides instead of combing forward into the face

designed.name: fringe section's edge: the forward comb meets the part and the sides

clumps.why: c01: 1.25 / cm2 gave 645 cards, 13.7k triangles, the scalp showing at the crown and the sides as flat panels; at 2.4 the card count comes from the budget (fit_budget trims the finest ranks to 26k)

operators.why: the fringe's line: 22 mm over the head centre's height at the middle (y 1.562: just above the brows), curving down a little toward the temples

growth.why: H2: each strand combs along the flow over the skull for attach_mm (longer from the crown, short at the hairline), at its own height over the SDF (1.5 mm at the hairline to 13 mm at the crown: the crown's hair lies over the lower layers, the volume a bob has), then hangs under gravity and settles

operators.why: the bob's line: level at the jaw (y 1.42-1.44), a touch shorter at the nape (a slight stack), blunt with 2.5 mm of jitter

e01: with a 40 / 9 mm tuck the sides fell straight from the skull's widest point and stood off the jaw, a dark gap beside the cheeks in the engine's front view; the lower 75 mm now curve in toward the jaw and neck by up to 16 mm, as a bob's ends turn under

scalp.why: H6: the scalp preset baked on the head's own UVs: the hair's cover under the cards (hairline fade, the part opened, the whorl's spiral), the near-scalp strands painted as fine stripes along their flow, the flow in the head's tangent frame
